method: Observed browser accessibility/DOM state, semantic control interaction and screenshot; production publication is checked separately after deployment.

checks.name: Generic identity and home
checks.observed: The brand returns to #atlas with title SAGUNTUM · Sagunto y Puerto de Sagunto, generic Sagunto/Puerto copy, 31 places and 6 regions.

checks.name: Sangre guide
checks.observed: The #sangre guide exposes 16 stops and 5 regions; starting the tour opens the first stop.

checks.name: Direct stop and independent progress
checks.observed: #sangre/sangre-cupula opens stop 9; selecting the nave through the plan opens stop 6 and increases the explored count.

checks.name: Chronology
checks.observed: The chronology tab presents the documented sequence from 1601 to the 2024 intervention.

checks.name: Sources and provenance
checks.observed: The source tab lists 22 references and the method; the La clau de la Sang dialog gives the author, 2025 publication, pages 124–143 and link.

checks.name: Plan selection
checks.observed: The modal contains 16 named stop buttons and a matching numbered plan; choosing Leer el interior desde su eje closes the modal and opens the correct stop.

checks.name: Thematic reading
checks.observed: Leer arquitectura, arte y memoria changes the pressed mode and displays the five-category legend in both the guide and full plan.

checks.name: WebGL fallback
checks.observed: Chrome reports WebGL disabled. The fallback provides access to the map/history, disables 3D section/detail actions and keeps the documentary interface usable.

webgl.observedError: GL_VENDOR=Disabled; GL_RENDERER=Disabled; Could not create a WebGL context

limitations: The screenshot proves the browser interface and 2D map, not WebGL rendering.
The 3D scene was inspected through renders exported from the actual regional constructor and its camera configuration.
Portrait and landscape camera checks use production framing functions; no physical phone or GPU benchmark is claimed.
